topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and outlines how previously learned immune components fit together.

topics.label: Innate pathogen recognition and pattern recognition receptor pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms and receptor pathways used by the innate immune system to detect microbial products and cellular damage.

topics.label: Cellular coordination and systemic progression of the inflammatory response
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how activated sentinel cells orchestrate leukocyte recruitment, fluid drainage, and systemic physiological responses during acute inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic containment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the active and passive mechanisms involved in ending inflammation, repairing damaged tissue, and containing persistent unresolved infections.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on the complement system.
